crossRefs.note: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the…
When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint;’
He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

translations.web: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
translations.bsb: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
translations.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
translations.asv: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.
